published_source: Printed Table 2, Panel A (log of quantity), column (2) of the published article (papers/mksc/mksc.2022.1356.pdf), read Nov 4 2026; equals the authors' code output to the printed decimals. Earlier: authors' reghdfe line re-run in Stata 16 on the shipped Data products.dta (two-way clustered SE store and skuT, N = 12891 after reghdfe singleton drop); published table value not available (no article text)
replication_status: exact (authors' code output -0.064606545276 (0.021191052659), N 12891, equals printed Table 2, Panel A (log of quantity), column (2) -0.065 (0.021), N 12,891, to the printed decimals; verified against the article Nov 4 2026)
treatment: label = 1 if the SKU carries at least one front-of-package warning label on that store visit day; first-treatment date = first observed labeled visit day of the store-SKU
notes: Store-SKU-day panel (store visit days, weekdays only), 56 visit days 2016-05-02..2016-07-22, 6 stores visited on 38-48 days each; rows exist only for store-SKU-days with item_qty >= 7 in the shipped file, so the panel is highly unbalanced (median 8 rows per store-SKU). Authors: reghdfe y label if category, absorb(group_store_sku a_week dow) cluster(store skuT) (docx code lines 12/26/40 for Tables 2-4, 64 for Table 6). fixest feols(y ~ label | group_store_sku + a_week + dow, cluster = ~store + skuT) reproduces the Stata re-run to 9 digits (SE to 6). No article text in the project: published table values not checked; published_coef is the authors' code re-run on the shipped data; table numbering (Tables 2/3/4 = cereals/chocolates/cookies, Table 6 columns in that order) is inferred from code comments. PIPELINE DEVIATIONS: (1) label is non-absorbing; run_spec drops post-adoption rows with label = 0 (Hull fn 6). (2) Calendar time = visit date, so run_spec's TWFE uses date FE, which nest the authors' additive week-of-year + day-of-week FE (each date maps to one week x dow cell). (3) Single cluster variable skuT instead of two-way store x skuT (only 6 stores). (4) run_spec keeps singletons (reghdfe drops them); coefficients unaffected. 957 store-SKUs: 467 never labeled, 278 switchers with an unlabeled pre-period (46 distinct first-label dates; 95 switch off), 212 labeled at first observation (50 switch off; 70 of them labeled on the first sample day); 487 post-adoption label = 0 rows dropped by run_spec. Authors' FE (week + dow) on the post-drop sample: -0.117309; date FE on the post-drop sample: -0.106713 (raw units).
